headline: Second judge blocks Trump's planned arch in Virginia
pages: A federal judge in Virginia said Friday she will issue a preliminary injunction blocking President Trump's planned triumphal arch indefinitely, NPR reports. District Judge Leonie Brinkema said she would grant a request from the Arlington County board, which sued over the arch in October. The 250-foot arch would stand in Memorial Circle, on the Virginia side of the Potomac near Arlington National Cemetery and Reagan National Airport. Arlington argues it would add noise, air pollution and traffic that could slow emergency vehicles, and disrupt sightlines and the cemetery's 24 to 27 weekday funerals. Plaintiffs also say the administration rushed its environmental review.
A Justice Department spokesperson said it will appeal immediately. NPR describes this as the second judge to block the project. Source: NPR
